costEntry.hint: This creates an expense in the account you select and links it to this item.
costEntry.sectionHint: Purchase cost comes from the item’s details. Track additional spending here; improvements increase the cost basis, while maintenance does not.
costEntry.maintenanceHint: Routine upkeep. Records an expense without changing the item’s cost basis or estimated value.
costEntry.improvementHint: Adds to the amount invested. The estimated market value changes only if you choose to update it.

costEntry.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
costEntry.investmentHint: Review payments linked to this investment. Manage purchases, sales and fees in Transactions.
costEntry.acquireFirst: Record upkeep between acquisition and sale, no later than today. Purchase payments can be linked separately.
costEntry.adjustValue: Also update the estimated market value
costEntry.independentValue: Spending more does not automatically make the item worth more. Leave this off to keep its valuation.
costEntry.valueRequired: Enter zero or a positive valuation increase.

performanceUnavailable: Performance unavailable: add the value when received.

ownership.closedHint: This item is no longer included in owned value. Its payments and history are retained.

ownership.positiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
ownership.availableQuantity: Quantity cannot exceed the units held.
ownership.nonNegativeFees: Fees must be zero or positive.
ownership.feesTooHigh: Fees must be less than the proceeds.
ownership.saleDateHint: Choose a date between acquisition and today.
ownership.openingHint: Recording an already-owned item creates no new payment. Link its existing purchase payment from the item’s details.

ownership.buyMoreHint: Records one payment in the linked account and adds the purchased units.
